newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea thanks Beijing and Manila over defector.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea thanks Beijing and Manila over defector.

text.p: South Korea's foreign ministry on Sunday thanked Beijing and Manila for their roles in the flight to South Korea of the most senior official to flee North Korea.

"We welcome his defection and we highly appreciate the Chinese government, which treated his defection in accordance with international law and procedure," ministry spokesman Suh Dae-won said in a televised news conference.

"We also express deep appreciation to the Philippine government and the public for its friendship and cooperation and for providing every convenience and allowing Hwang to stay in the Philippines for more than one month," Suh said.
Hwang defected in Beijing on February 12 and has been in the Philippines since March 18, but his whereabouts have been kept a tight secret.
State-run Korea Broadcasting System said Hwang was expected to arrive in South Korea at around noon local time (0300 GMT) on Sunday after leaving Manila on a Boeing 737 chartered flight.
